confidence_notes: Coimbra restaurant meal, cappuccino, and draught beer anchors follow Numbeo's October 2026 city averages (549 entries from 65 contributors in the prior 12 months). Cocktail is anchored to a recent Coimbra price report; the wine-glass estimate uses its local relationship to draught beer because an aggregated restaurant glass price was unavailable. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from Coimbra's mid-sized university-city market and are especially seasonal.
comparable_city_reasoning: A mid-sized Portuguese university and regional center, with restaurant prices below Lisbon and broadly comparable to other central Portuguese cities.
